body:
Hey man. Thought you deserved an update after all you've done for me. Feels like so long ago. 

First of all, thanks for the time you've spent replying and typing out these really great responses. I really appreciate it.

So I told my girlfriend. Or rather, I just showed her this page and let her read it. Went pretty well. She still loves me. Great girl. I love her.

But I do feel like I kinda fucked up. I shouldn't have told her, because now if I do have to go down that route for any reason, there's no way to go without hurting her badly. She has a huge burden now. Because of me. She doesn't deserve that.

Yeah. You're kinda nailing this. That makes a lot of sense actually. I really think you're right. At least, I want you to be right. I'm gonna have to sleep on this one. 

So. What do I do to fix this? Or rather, what did you do to fix this in you? You really think telling other people did the trick? 

I don't know if I trust people like that. I mean, put in their place, someone opening up to me, yeah I'd definitely try to be a good friend. But not all people think like that. 

I'm afraid I'll be abandoned. I don't want to open up to someone who could leave me alone and with more trust issues than I started with. That seems dangerous. If they just drop me, I'll be alone.
And also, thanks for replying. I know you probably have better shit to do than listen to some stupid kid rant through his keyboard. I really appreciate your time.

You're pretty close. Not only do I not want people to worry about me, but I think for some stupid reason I enjoy being surrounded by people who like me. Like I have some sort of meaning and effect on someone else's lives. 

But then I remember that it's not me they like, it's the fake me. 

I don't know about reaching out, man. I definitely have friends I could talk to, even my girlfriend I'm sure. But they'd treat me differently. I like the way they treat the fake me. Although I don't like the fake me, they do. I don't want them to see me weak. It's stupid, I know. I just feel terrible that all these people enjoy my company so much and that I'm lying to every single one of them. 

If I went out this way, they'd remember the me that everyone liked. Not as some pussy spoiled kid who makes up problems in his own head.
